name: Keeper of the Flame
summary: At Westfall Lighthouse, Captain Grayson keeps watch over the coast. The spectral sailor seeks oil to keep the beacon burning after murlocs killed the living keepers, so ships can pass the reefs safely.

sections.title: A Spectral Duty
sections.body: Westfall Lighthouse stands on a rocky islet off the zone’s southwest shore, where its light once guided sailors through the Great Sea’s shallow waters. That duty ended when Old Murk-Eye led a murloc attack and killed the keeper and his family. Captain Grayson, a sailor who died in the waters by these rocks, now watches over the tower as a ghost. Death left him unable to stop the slaughter, but he will not let the lighthouse go dark.

sections.title: Fueling the Beacon
sections.body: No living keeper remains to tend the flame, so Captain Grayson needs an unusual fuel. The rogue Harvest Watchers roaming Westfall’s abandoned farmlands carry flasks of machinery oil inside their rusted bodies. Grayson sends you ashore to recover the oil from these broken constructs. With it, the beacon can keep burning and guide other captains past the reefs.

aliases: who is the ghost at westfall lighthouse
faq.answer: Captain Grayson is the ghost of a sailor who shipwrecked and died on Westfall’s dangerous coast. He watches over Westfall Lighthouse to help keep living sailors from meeting the same fate.

faq.q: What happened to the original lighthouse keepers?
faq.answer: Old Murk-Eye led the murloc attack that killed the lighthouse keeper and his family. Captain Grayson watched the massacre helplessly as a ghost.

faq.q: Where does the oil for the lighthouse flame come from?
faq.answer: The oil comes from the mechanical Harvest Watchers roaming Westfall’s abandoned farms and fields.

faq.q: Why does Grayson care about keeping the beacon lit?
faq.answer: Grayson wants the beacon to guide sailors across the Great Sea past the coastal rocks. He died on those reefs and now watches over the lighthouse.
Old Murk-Eye is a notorious murloc who prowls Westfall’s coast and leads attacks on shore settlements. His raiders killed the lighthouse keeper and his family.

faq.q: Where is the Westfall Lighthouse located?
faq.answer: Westfall Lighthouse stands on a rocky islet off Westfall’s southwestern coast. You can reach it by swimming through the shallow coastal waters.

angles.text: The Westfall beacon helps keep trade ships and naval vessels bound for Stormwind Harbor from running aground along the kingdom’s crumbling coast.
Harvest Watchers roaming Westfall’s farms carry volatile machine fluids that can fuel a lantern.
